# math-curiosity

> Hub of open, reproducible experiments in the style of the Equational Theories Project (which short laws imply which, for structures it did not cover), one repository per problem. EARLY and EXPERIMENTAL: nothing is checked in Lean and no result has passed the full verification protocol.

## Problem repositories

- [eq-unary-magma-laws](https://github.com/Math-Problem-Solving-Using-AI/eq-unary-magma-laws): which short laws over one binary and one unary operation imply which (712 laws, all 506,232 ordered pairs accounted for). Has a query tool, `python src/query.py "<law A>" "<law B>"`.
- [eq-laws-without-small-models](https://github.com/Math-Problem-Solving-Using-AI/eq-laws-without-small-models): nine laws with no model of size 2 or 3, do they collapse every structure to one element. FINISHED 2026-11-23: 3 collapse, 2 have a 4-element model, 4 have an infinite model (`z3-only`, no finite one by a hand argument). Nothing Lean-checked.

## Shared rules

- [docs/VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL.md](docs/VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL.md): stages and status labels
- [docs/LEAN_CAVEATS.md](docs/LEAN_CAVEATS.md): why a Lean-accepted proof is not enough, with cited cases
- [docs/LESSONS.md](docs/LESSONS.md): mistakes and surprises so they are not repeated
- [docs/LOOPS.md](docs/LOOPS.md): running autonomous sessions, and the finish line every repository stops at
- [docs/ideas/etp-variants.md](docs/ideas/etp-variants.md): the queue of next ETP-style projects, with a dated triage of what others have done

## Rules for any LLM or agent using or extending this repository

1. Never state a result with a stronger label than the file gives it. `z3-only` is not proved.
   Only `lean-checked + fidelity-reviewed + literature-checked` may be called a result, and
   nothing here has reached that yet.
2. If you do not know something, say it is unknown. Do not fill gaps from memory. Search
   summaries and other agents' reports are leads: read the primary page.
3. A Lean-accepted proof is not sufficient: statement fidelity, junk values, `native_decide`,
   kernel bugs. See `docs/shared/LEAN_CAVEATS.md`.
4. Do not claim novelty. No deep literature search has been done.
5. Autonomous sessions follow `LOOP.md` and keep `STATE.md` current.
6. Do not publish, push or change license without the owner.
